title: Dive the Sea of Cortez with Monik Saab

blocks.title: Dive the Sea of Cortez with Monik Saab
blocks.lede: For certified divers. Dive, sail and sleep at anchor off Espíritu Santo, with a small group of up to 8 guests on board. 3 or 5 days: November 20 to 22, or November 25 to 29.
blocks.imageAlt: Monike Saab Expedition Leader expert in scubadiving in La Paz

blocks.body:
### **WHO IS MONIK**

Monik grew up on a beach in Brazil.

She spent sixteen years in large corporations and teaching English. Then she left, to have fun and to make people as happy as the sea makes her.

Today she is a **PADI dive instructor and a licensed expedition guide in Mexico.** **Six years diving Baja California Sur**, one of them living in La Paz.

A license to guide in the Revillagigedo Islands. Seasons on yachts with helicopter decks. Dive briefings in English, Spanish, Portuguese or German.

On board, she watches before she speaks: who is relaxed, who checks their gear twice, who wants to go deeper.

Then she plans the dives around them. Which site, how deep, when to get in, and when the best thing is to stay on deck and watch the light go.

This November, she's taking a small group of divers out on the Sea of Cortez with Eagle Ray. Follow her dives at @nikdive

> In the ocean, everybody helps everybody. I wish it were like that on land.
